lines.en: Fins sway, gold glints.
Scales glide, through the dark.
Moves gracefully, body light.
Avoids shadows, swiftly swims.
Gold tail flicks, over the surface.
Swims in shadows, elusive.
Silver scales, golden body, through the water.
Body curves, golden motion.
Golden body, slow swim.
Golden shadow, swims in water.
One flick of my tail, and I pass through fallen petals.
I swim slowly around the lily roots.
Rests quietly, in water.
Golden body, waits in peace.
Swims on surface, gold glints.
Swims slowly, gold elusive.
Golden scales, still in water.
Golden body, waits in water.
Relaxed swim, gold glints.
Golden scales, still in water.
Golden body, swims leisurely.
Golden body, calm in water.

lines.zh: 我停在花瓣落下的水面。
lines.en: I hover where petals fall on the water.

lines.zh: 水底的卵石被我拨得发亮。
lines.en: I nudge the pebbles below until they shine.
I wait for small flies to land on the water.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水面，照在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight passes the surface and rests on my back.
Notices player, eyes gleam.
Golden eyes, focus on player.
Golden scales, body quivers.
Fins sway, alert to player.
Golden tail, sways alert.
Golden body, watches player.
Scales reflect, golden gaze.
Golden eyes, seek player.
Golden fins, swaying alert.
Golden tail, sways to watch.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我浮上来看。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank, so I rise to look.
Your fingers have muddled the ripples.
I do not fear you, only nets.

lines.zh: 水波把我的花纹晃歪了。
lines.en: The ripples skew my patterns.
You crushed the moss on the bank.
You stand on the bank. I am in your reflection.
Did you bring a fishing rod?
The monsters around here keep away from me.
My scales are crooked!
That really hurts…
My scales are broken!
That stings…
That wound hurts!
I'm hurt!
I'm injured…
That wound is deep!
Blood is still flowing.
I'm dizzy.

lines.zh: 诱惑我，你就会看见我的美丽！
lines.en: Tempt me, and you'll see my beauty!
Kin Showa Koi, hard to resist!

lines.zh: 我有最美的金色鳞片，谁来试一试？
lines.en: I have the most beautiful golden scales, who will try?
Golden temptation, who can resist?

lines.zh: 我的花纹引人注目，你想试试吗？
lines.en: My patterns catch the eye, do you want to try?

lines.zh: 金色与黑色交织，多么迷人！
lines.en: Gold and black intertwined, how alluring!

lines.zh: 金色光辉闪烁，谁能拒绝？
lines.en: Golden light shines, who can resist?

lines.zh: 金色鳞片中藏着秘密，来挑战吧！
lines.en: Golden scales hold secrets, come and challenge!
Gold and black, your prey!

lines.zh: 金色鳞片下的力量，等着你发现！
lines.en: Power beneath the golden scales, waiting for you to discover!
Kin Showa, avoid my collision!
Collision only brings pain!

lines.zh: 你触碰了不该碰的东西！
lines.en: You touched something you shouldn't have!
Collision is an unwise choice!

lines.zh: 我的身体碰你一下，你会后悔！
lines.en: I'll bump you, and you'll regret it!
Touch me, and you'll be hurt!
Stay away, or there will be a collision!

lines.zh: 小心，我的身体会碰撞你！
lines.en: Be careful, I'll collide with you!
Collision is something you don't want!
Don't get close, or there will be a collision!
Find a mate, swim with me!
Kin Showa Koi, find a mate!
I have the perfect mate, come on!
Swim together, find a mate!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣就在附近，快来吧！
lines.en: My mate is nearby, come over!
Kin Showa Koi, enjoy the mate!

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，我会是你最好的选择！
lines.en: Find a mate, I'm your best choice!

lines.zh: 和我一起游泳，成为我的伴侣！
lines.en: Swim with me, be my mate!
My mate, our future!
Swim together, find true love!
Glows faintly with metallic light.

lines.zh: 你注意到它的花纹比普通锦鲤更独特。
lines.en: You notice its pattern is more unique than regular koi.

lines.zh: 你惊讶于它竟然能游动。
lines.en: You're surprised it can swim.

lines.zh: 金昭和的鳞，在水里一闪。
lines.en: Kin Showa scales flash in the water.

lines.zh: 你听见它缓慢的呼吸声。
lines.en: You hear its slow breathing.

lines.zh: 它身体上的花纹像火焰在跳动。
lines.en: Its patterns move like flames.

lines.zh: 它开始慢慢地向你游过来。
lines.en: It slowly swims towards you.

lines.zh: 你感觉到它身上有股冷气。
lines.en: You feel a chill from it.
Its scales reflect a faint light.
Blood is on its mouth.

lines.zh: 盯上了你，开始加速游动。
lines.en: It locks onto you and speeds up.
It approaches you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 金纹一摆，我朝那道影子冲。
lines.en: One flick of my gold pattern and I charge that shadow.
It slowly approaches to devour.
It opens its mouth, showing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中充满了杀意。
lines.en: Its eyes are filled with malice.

lines.zh: 它潜伏在阴影中，等待时机。
lines.en: It lurks in the shadows, waiting for an opportunity.
It slowly advances.

lines.zh: 它似乎在思考下一步行动。
lines.en: It seems to consider its next move.

lines.zh: 它的眼神充满了对猎物的渴望。
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with hunger for prey.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子，我盯住了。
lines.en: I have fixed on that shadow on the surface.
Something is moving under the lotus leaf.

lines.zh: 我朝那个晃动的方向游。
lines.en: I swim toward that swaying spot.

lines.zh: 这圈涟漪不是风造出来的。
lines.en: These ripples were not made by wind.
I slip through the gap between the pebbles.
The moment it showed itself, I saw it.

lines.zh: 它在水中游动，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: It swims, seeking its next target.
It swims across the surface, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它快速地游动，寻找猎物。
lines.en: It swims quickly, searching for prey.
It swims rapidly in the water.

lines.zh: 它寻找着可以吞噬的对象。
lines.en: It searches for something to devour.
It swims back and forth in the water.
It swims around, searching for prey.
It searches for prey at the bottom.

lines.zh: 它在水中游动寻找食物。
lines.en: It swims in search of food.
It swims around in the water.
One screen of weeds and I am around it.
The weeds snag its feet. Perfect.
I count the rhythm of its tail.
I wait until it nears the shallows.
I muddy the water to hide myself.

lines.zh: 它退到石缝里，我也跟过去。
lines.en: It backs into a stone gap, and I follow.
Beneath the petals, I keep my eyes on it.
One more foot closer, and I bite.
Sssss, do you want to eat me?
Come on, taste my sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 金昭和的攻击不是闹着玩的！
lines.en: Kin Showa's attack is no joke!
Clamp down on you, where will you run?

lines.zh: 金光闪闪的我可不好对付！
lines.en: I'm Kin Showa, not easy to handle!
Feel my speed and strength!

lines.zh: 金昭和的威胁不只是外表！
lines.en: Kin Showa's threat goes beyond appearance!

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则后悔莫及！
lines.en: Stay away from me, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 我的利齿让你难以吞咽！
lines.en: My sharp teeth make it hard to swallow!

lines.zh: 金昭和，绝不轻易放过你！
lines.en: Kin Showa, won't let you go easily!
I burst out of the water and ram it!
My tail slaps up a sheet of spray!
I clamp its ankle and hold on!
I drag it toward the deep water!
The spray blinds its eyes!
I spin and splash its face.

lines.zh: 水域是我的领地，快滚开！
lines.en: This water is my territory, get out!
Blossom Woods, my home, stay away!

lines.zh: 这里是我的水域，怪物别想进来！
lines.en: This is my water, monsters can't come in!
Don't disturb my peace!

lines.zh: 这里是安全的水域，怪物不敢靠近！
lines.en: This is safe water, monsters won't dare to approach!

lines.zh: 我的存在让这里没有怪物！
lines.en: My presence keeps monsters away here!

lines.zh: 怪物靠近，金昭和会守护！
lines.en: Monsters approaching, Kin Showa protects!

lines.zh: 这里是金昭和的地盘，别惹我！
lines.en: This is Kin Showa's territory, don't provoke me!

lines.zh: 我的存在阻止怪物生成！
lines.en: My presence stops monster spawning!

lines.zh: 怪物靠近，金昭和现身警告！
lines.en: Monsters approach, Kin Showa appears to warn!
When the blossoms open, I am in the water.

lines.zh: 这池塘的怪物都被我赶走了。
lines.en: I have driven every monster out of this pond.
A lily pad flips, and I surface.
When the water clears, I appear.
The water of this blossom grove knows me.
I swim out of the drifted petals.

lines.zh: 十六格内，别想有别的东西。
lines.en: Within sixteen blocks, nothing else dares to be.
In this shallow bend, there is only me.

lines.zh: 我的金鳞被火烤得发白。
lines.en: Fire has bleached my golden scales.
Hit a rock!

lines.zh: 我在自己家里，却喘不上气！
lines.en: In my own home, and I cannot breathe!

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被掀到岸上！
lines.en: The blast split the water and threw me onto the bank!

lines.zh: 箭头扎穿水面，钉住我的鳍！
lines.en: The arrow pierced the surface and pinned my fin!

lines.zh: 我背上的金红斑，被法术烧暗。
lines.en: Magic dimmed the gold-red on my back.
No insects in the water. I am hungry.

lines.zh: 闪电落下来，金鳞都发白了。
lines.en: The bolt fell and turned my gold scales pale.
Fell into the void!
